item.title: Shaheen Afridi doubtful for T20 World Cup 2026 after suffering knee injury in BBL: Report
item.description: With nearly a month remaining for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, Pakistan have suffered a major setback as their key pacer Shaheen Afridi is currently doubtful for the showpiece tournament. item.title: Ashes 2025-26: “I think he will retire,” Michael Clarke expects Sydney Test to be Usman Khawaja’s international farewell
item.description: Former Australia skipper Michael Clarke has said that Usman Khawaja will definitely feature in the Ashes finale at SCG, while also predicting that it will be the veteran left-hander’s farewell Test. item.title: Padikkal, Sarfaraz, Gaikwad slam VHT 2025-26 tons to stake claim for spot in India team for New Zealand ODIs
item.description: Devdutt Padikkal of Karnataka, Sarfaraz Khan of Mumbai, and Ruturaj Gaikwad of Maharashtra hammered centuries in the ongoing Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT 2025-26) tournament. item.title: Jasprit Bumrah retains no.1 spot in ICC Test rankings as Mitchell Starc closes in; Shubman Gill enters top 10 of Test batting rankings
item.description: Mitchell Starc, the star Australian fast bowler, gained one position to become the new world No. 2 Test bowler in the latest ICC rankings revealed on Wednesday (December 31). The left-arm bowler, who dismissed four English batters in two innings during the Boxing Day Test at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, has 843 rating points. item.title: WATCH- “I told her, if I get a wicket, I’ll celebrate like this”- Vaishnavi Sharma on special celebration with Harmanpreet Kaur
item.description: Newbie Indian women’s cricketer Vaishnavi Sharma has spilled the beans about the viral new celebration with India captain Harmanpreet Kaur after the recent fifth and final T20I against Sri Lanka on December 30. item.title: VHT 2025-26: “We know each other very well”- Sarfaraz Khan on batting with brother Musheer for Mumbai
item.description: Sarfaraz Khan is having a dream run for Mumbai in the ongoing Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT 2025-26). item.title: ‘Yuvraj Singh’s bat swing, Virat Kohli’s white-ball domination’- Jerrssis Wadia, Adelaide Strikers star, learning from legends
item.description: Adelaide Strikers all-rounder Jerrssis Wadia has stated that he was strongly impressed by Yuvraj Singh's superb swing of the bat and fluid batting style, and that he also idolizes ace India batter Virat Kohli. Wadia has impressed for the Adelaide Strikers in the Big Bash League (BBL) 2025-26, most notably when he hammered Brisbane Heat all-rounder Jack Wildermuth for 24 runs in a single over.
